participant_id.Description: Person identifier (as in the source, normalized where noted).

session_id.Description: Scan session identifier within the participant.

viscode.Description: A4 visit code of the MRI.

scan_day.Description: Day of the MRI, from consent.

days_from_randomization.Description: Day of the MRI, from randomization (A4) or baseline (LEARN).

screening_amyloid_read.Description: Florbetapir visual read at screening (per participant).

screening_amyloid_suvr.Description: Florbetapir cortical SUVR (cerebellar reference) at screening (per participant).

pacc.Description: Preclinical Alzheimer Cognitive Composite (z-score sum). Within 90 days of the MRI.

mmse.Description: Mini-Mental State Examination (0-30). Within 90 days of the MRI.

fcsrt96.Description: Free and Cued Selective Reminding Test (0-96). Within 90 days of the MRI.

logical_memory_delayed.Description: Logical Memory delayed paragraph recall (0-25). Within 90 days of the MRI.

digit_symbol.Description: Digit Symbol Substitution score. Within 90 days of the MRI.

cfi.Description: Cognitive Function Index, participant + partner. Within 90 days of the MRI.

adl.Description: ADCS Activities of Daily Living (prevention), participant + partner. Within 90 days of the MRI.

cdr_global.Description: Clinical Dementia Rating, global score. Within 90 days of the MRI.

cdr_sb.Description: Clinical Dementia Rating, sum of boxes. Within 90 days of the MRI.

pacc_change_wk240.Description: PACC change from baseline at week 240 (per participant).

amyloid_suvr.Description: Florbetapir composite SUVR (cerebellar reference), within 1 year of the MRI.

tau_mubada_suvr.Description: Flortaucipir MUBADA SUVR (PERSI reference), within 1 year.

tau_early_suvr.Description: Flortaucipir early-tau region SUVR (PERSI reference), within 1 year.

tau_entorhinal_suvr.Description: Flortaucipir entorhinal SUVR, mean of left and right (PERSI reference), within 1 year.

plasma_ptau217.Description: Plasma pTau217 (Lilly), within 1 year of the MRI.
